venue.notes: Lincoln Financial Field (kept, U_BRIEF). 2026 end zones: midnight green paint with the classic EAGLES wordmark (white letters, black and silver trim, green arch) as in the week 1 2026 photos; the retail NFL shield and NFC logo beside it are dropped (INFERRED). Midfield: the eagle head (official SVG, full colour, a manual item). Both end zones share one texture in s21. The 2004 player poster becomes a 2026 poster (Hurts, Barkley, Smith, Carter from their official headshots, a manual item). wall02 (the eagle logo, unchanged since 1996) and wall03 (philadelphiaeagles.com tickets, still valid) stay retail; cover01 keeps its pre-2008 NFL shield until an NFL shield master exists (open).
